import os, sys, json
from reflex.style import convert_dict_to_style_and_format_emotion

TARGET_FILE = os.path.realpath('/testbed/reflex/style.py')
ALLOWED = {
    'convert_dict_to_style_and_format_emotion',
    '__init__',
    'update',
    '__setitem__',
    'convert',
    'convert_list',
    'convert_item',
    'format_style_key',
    'format_as_emotion',
    '_format_emotion_style_pseudo_selector',
    'media_query',
}

path=[]

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    if event == 'line':
        fn = os.path.realpath(frame.f_code.co_filename)
        name = frame.f_code.co_name
        if fn == TARGET_FILE and name in ALLOWED:
            path.append({'file': os.path.relpath(fn, '/testbed'), 'func': name, 'line': frame.f_lineno})
    return tracer

raw_style = {
    'margin_x': '12px',
    '_hover': {
        'color': 'tomato',
        'padding_y': ['2px', '4px'],
    },
    'font_size': ['12px', '14px', '16px'],
    '--accent-color': 'teal',
}

sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    emotion_style = convert_dict_to_style_and_format_emotion(raw_style)
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)

# verify behavior mirrors test assertions
assert str(emotion_style['marginInlineStart']) == '"12px"'
assert str(emotion_style['marginInlineEnd']) == '"12px"'
assert str(emotion_style['&:hover']['color']) == '"tomato"'
assert str(emotion_style['&:hover']['@media screen and (min-width: 30em)']['paddingTop']) == '"4px"'
assert str(emotion_style['@media screen and (min-width: 48em)']['fontSize']) == '"16px"'
assert str(emotion_style['--accent-color']) == '"teal"'

print(json.dumps(path, indent=2))
PY
